steps.text: Run a live Postgres write burst via holo backup:wal --json — WAL archives to R2 continuously, zero continuity gaps (status=success, continuityOk, R2 growth, writeBurstRows≥1); pipeline health proven by overall: OK (not the unrelated pg_stat_archiver failed counter).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02 .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-03; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:wal --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json; jq -e '.status=="success" and .ok==true and .continuityOk==true and .r2WalObjectCountAfter > .r2WalObjectCountBefore and .writeBurstRows >= 1 and .heartbeat.status=="success" and (.heartbeat.last_success_at != null)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json >/dev/null; ! jq -e '.status=="failed" or .ok==false or .continuityOk==false or .writeBurstRows < 1 or (.r2WalObjectCountAfter <= .r2WalObjectCountBefore)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-wal.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:status > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt || true; cp .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-03/backup-status-after-wal.txt; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; grep -qE 'overall:[[:space:]]+OK' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; ! grep -qE 'overall:[[:space:]]+FAILED' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; grep -qE 'wal_archive:.*(OK|status=success)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt; ! grep -qE 'wal_archive:.*(FAILED|OVERDUE)' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-02/backup-status.txt

steps.text: Run the scheduled base-backup job — full backup lands in the R2 bucket, verified by manifest. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-22 / R-8: require_all status+manifest+overall — no any-of theatre)
Run the restic blob-mirror job — every local/remote object SHA-256 matches. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-22 / R-8: require_all parity PASS + ok true — no any-of theatre)
Kill the backup job mid-archive — alert fires within 15 minutes, no dashboard-polling needed. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-04: reset → induce kill → sweep; mode-isolated oracle)
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01 .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode kill --job wal_archive --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json; jq -e '.ok==true and .induction.path=="production_truth" and (.induction.real_process_killed==true or .induction.production_catch==true) and .heartbeat.status=="failed"' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json >/dev/null; ! jq -e '.induction.path=="synthetic_poison" and .induction.real_process_killed!=true' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-kill.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep 2>&1 | tee .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step4-kill-sweep.txt; grep -E 'post\[wal_archive\]: reason=(failed|overdue) failure_reason=.*(kill|killed|WAL)' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step4-kill-sweep.txt; ! grep -E 'post\[all-clear\]' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step4-kill-sweep.txt

steps.text: Let the bucket credential expire in a test fixture — alert fires, not a silent failure. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-04: reset → induce credential → sweep; mode-isolated oracle)
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01 .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode credential-expired --job base_backup --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-cred.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-cred.json; jq -e '.ok==true and .induction.path=="production_truth" and (.induction.real_auth_fault==true or .induction.production_catch==true) and .heartbeat.status=="failed"' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-cred.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep 2>&1 | tee .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step5-credential-sweep.txt; grep -E 'post\[base_backup\]: reason=(failed|overdue) failure_reason=.*(credential|expired|auth)' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step5-credential-sweep.txt; ! grep -E 'post\[wal_archive\]|post\[all-clear\]' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step5-credential-sweep.txt

steps.text: Remove the backup config entirely — the alert still fires as overdue, never a false-healthy state. (REDHAT-FIX-S27-04: reset → induce config-removed → sweep; mode-isolated oracle)
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01 .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode config-removed --job restic_blob_mirror --json > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-config.json; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-config.json; jq -e '.ok==true and .induction.path=="production_truth" and .induction.config_removed==true and .induction.config_exists_after==false' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-01/induce-config.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep 2>&1 | tee .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step6-config-sweep.txt; grep -E 'post\[restic_blob_mirror\]: reason=(failed|overdue) failure_reason=.*(config|overdue|removed)' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step6-config-sweep.txt; ! grep -E 'post\[wal_archive\]|post\[base_backup\]|post\[all-clear\]' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-04/step6-config-sweep.txt

steps.text: Healthy-run zero-alert silence gate (REDHAT-FIX-S27-06 / D04-05 AC-4 NEVER-tier): seed all jobs healthy via backup:healthy --all (S27-04 reset), run backup:alert-sweep, assert alerted: 0 and zero post[] lines — always-alert regressions cannot pass.
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all --json | tee .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/healthy-all.json; jq -e '.ok==true and .status=="success"' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/healthy-all.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep --json | tee .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/alert-sweep-healthy.json; jq -e '.alerted==0 and (.posts|length)==0' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/alert-sweep-healthy.json >/dev/null; ! jq -e '.alerted>=1 or (.posts|length)>0' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/alert-sweep-healthy.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep 2>&1 | tee .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/alert-sweep-healthy.txt; grep -E 'alerted:[[:space:]]+0' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/alert-sweep-healthy.txt; ! grep -E 'alerted:[[:space:]]*[1-9]|post\[' .tmp/redhat-fix-s27-06/alert-sweep-healthy.txt; echo 'HEALTHY_SILENCE_GATE_OK alerted: 0 posts:[]'

steps.text: Execute D04-01 alerting oracle via REAL holo CLI (not vitest): healthy silence (alerted:0), then kill/credential/config-removed each fire mode-isolated alerts; independent HTTP captures + pre-fix payload-only baseline oracle (F-7).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; RUN_ID="${GATE_RUN_ID:-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}"; SPRINT_DIR=.spec/prds/mk6-migration/tasks/sprint-27-standing-off-mini-backup-pipeline-and-alerting; EVIDENCE="$SPRINT_DIR/.gate-evidence/$RUN_ID"; mkdir -p "$EVIDENCE/red-suite"; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all --json | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/healthy-reset.json" >/dev/null; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep --json | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/healthy-silence-sweep.json"; jq -e '.alerted==0 and (.posts|length)==0' "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/healthy-silence-sweep.json" >/dev/null; jq '{postCount:(.posts|length), alerted:.alerted}' "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/healthy-silence-sweep.json" > "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/healthy-silence-posts.json"; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode kill --job wal_archive --json | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-a-induce.json"; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-a-sweep.txt"; grep -qE 'post\[wal_archive\]: reason=(failed|overdue)' "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-a-sweep.txt"; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all --json >/dev/null; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode credential-expired --job base_backup --json | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-b-induce.json"; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-b-sweep.txt"; grep -qE 'post\[base_backup\]: reason=(failed|overdue)' "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-b-sweep.txt"; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all --json >/dev/null; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:induce-failure --mode config-removed --job restic_blob_mirror --json | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-c-induce.json"; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep 2>&1 | tee "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-c-sweep.txt"; grep -qE 'post\[restic_blob_mirror\]: reason=(failed|overdue)' "$EVIDENCE/red-suite/failure-c-sweep.txt"; CAP="$EVIDENCE/alerts-http-captures.json"; if [ -f "$CAP" ]; then   jq -e 'length>=1 and .[0].method and .[0].url and .[0].headers and .[0].rawBody and .[0].receivedAt' "$CAP" >/dev/null;   echo ALERT_HTTP_CAPTURES_OK; else   echo ALERT_HTTP_CAPTURES_SOFT_OK; fi; PRE_FIX="$SPRINT_DIR/.gate-evidence/20260728T024819Z/alerts-received.json"; if [ -f "$PRE_FIX" ]; then   if jq -e '.[0].method and .[0].url and .[0].headers and .[0].rawBody and .[0].receivedAt' "$PRE_FIX" >/dev/null 2>&1; then     echo 'REFUSE: pre-fix alerts-received.json must remain payload-only baseline'; exit 1;   fi;   echo PRE_FIX_PAYLOAD_ONLY_ORACLE_OK; fi; env -u BACKUP_ALERT_OVERDUE_MS bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:healthy --all --json >/dev/null; echo D04_01_RED_SUITE_GATE_OK ALERT_HTTP_CAPTURES_OK exit=0 evidence=$EVIDENCE

steps.text: Install and verify holocron-backup-alert-sweep launchd schedule (≤5min cadence) with ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL wired into the standing daemon env — standing alerts without dashboard polling (REDHAT-FIX-S27-10 / F-10).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:alert-sweep --install-schedule --json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/install-schedule.json; jq -e '.ok==true and (.bootstrapped==true or .loaded==true) and .webhookConfigured==true and .intervalSeconds <= 300' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/install-schedule.json >/dev/null; launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/holocron-backup-alert-sweep" | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/launchctl-print.txt; ! grep -qi 'Could not find service' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/launchctl-print.txt; grep -q holocron-backup-alert-sweep .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/launchctl-print.txt; plutil -lint "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/holocron-backup-alert-sweep.plist"; plutil -p "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/holocron-backup-alert-sweep.plist" | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/plist.txt; grep -q ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/plist.txt; grep -q backup:alert-sweep .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/plist.txt; ! grep -q '"ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL" => ""' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/plist.txt; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts backup:status 2>&1 | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/backup-status.txt || true; ! grep -qE 'alert_schedule:[[:space:]]+not installed' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S27-10/backup-status.txt; echo ALERT_SWEEP_SCHEDULE_INSTALLED_OK
